body.statement: Uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{Lap}}\), the fourth-cumulant construction satisfies \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{Lap}}}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes N}}\|\widehat\Gamma_N^{\mathrm{Lap}}-\Gamma(P)\|_{\mathrm{op}}=O(N^{-1/2})\), \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{Lap}}}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes N}}d_H(\Theta_{TY}(\widehat\Gamma_N^{\mathrm{Lap}},\preceq),\Theta_{TY}(\Gamma(P),\preceq))=O(N^{-1/2})\), and \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{Lap}}}P^{\otimes N}\{\Theta_{TY}(\Gamma(P),\preceq)\subseteq C_N^{\mathrm{Lap}}\}\ge1-\alpha\) for every \(N\).
body.justification: The theorem locates a transparent parametric boundary of the severely ill-posed Fourier class.
body.gap: Miettinen--Taskinen--Nordhausen--Oja derives fourth-moment ICA limits, but not finite-sample whole-fiber coverage for a greatest Gaussian divisor.
body.consumer: Audited literal-Laplace applications can use root-\(N\) uncertainty rather than the conservative logarithmic region.
